IF no phase has |t|>=3 the trial is recorded as 'no mechanism' and no clock is chosen

name: holistic_gbm_rerank
rationale: Holistic test: one gradient-boosted model (sklearn HistGradientBoostingRegressor, fixed hyper-params: max_iter=200, lr=0.05, max_leaf_nodes=15, min_samples_leaf=200, l2=1.0; no tuning) on ALL features at once - S0, idio336 pct, funding pct, funding change 3d, flow72 pct, ret 24/72/168h resid, idio share, near-high, 168h beta, vol-spike ratio, max |z| 8h, var-ratio, 24h volume pct, settlement-phase drift, universe size - all pct-ranked inside M at offset-0 rebalance rows. Target: cross-sectional pct rank of forward residual return rows i+2..i+73 (72h). Walk-forward: model for year Y trained only on rows with target window ending before Jan 1 of Y (2021..2025; 2020 not traded -> uses B-MV). Use: re-rank ONLY inside the book's candidate sets (short: from top NS+8 by S0 keep the NS lowest predicted; long: from bottom NL+8 keep the NL highest predicted); S0 selection otherwise unchanged. Pre-screen: OOS rank IC of prediction inside the candidate sets, each year 2021-25, must be >0 on average with NW t>=1.5; then 8-clock book trial on 2021-2025 vs B-MV, same adoption bar.
verdict: pre-screen PASS (in-cand IC 0.065 t11.7, no leak) but book FAIL (t -1.68)

name: reweight_band
rationale: Cost/structure idea (lesson from W06: cutting noise-trading works, changing holdings does not). minvar_floor re-weights CONTINUING names at every rebalance (small |dw| from covariance drift) and charges 5.5bp on each. Rule: at a rebalance, a coin held on the same side before and after keeps its old weight if |w_new - w_old| < band * |w_old|; entries/exits and sign flips are untouched (unlike the failed T25 partial rebalance, which also slowed entries). Leg sums may drift slightly from 0.45/0.55 (disclosed). Family band in {0.15, 0.30, 0.50}, primary 0.30; walk-forward over the family; plateau = the other two.
